Those new battery packs are actually droids with some movement and manipulation functions&hellip;plus they’re functional battery packs, though they don’t contain as many shots as their displays claim.|Voort saBinring and Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Battery-pack parasite droids''' were small [[Droid/Legends|droids]] shaped like [[Battery/Legends|battery]] packs for [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]]. They were used by the recently reformed [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]]<ref name="MK" /> in [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> who planted them on a number of [[Galactic Alliance Army]] blaster rifles during their investigation of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]. They had a very limited amount of charge and also could move independently, as well as subvert other simple droids. The droids were equipped with sensors and burst-transmitters for surveillance.<ref name="MK" />
